responses:
**Don't send the offer based on this analysis.** Two of its three items don't match the tender, and it leaves out most of the requirements, including ones that could get the offer rejected.

## Errors in the analysis

| # | Analysis says | Tender actually says | Problem |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Warranty: 7.1 requires **5 years** | 7.1: **24 months** from commissioning (`tender.md:29`) | Wrong figure. The offer may still comply, since 5 years is more than 24 months, but the stated requirement is wrong. |
| 2 | Paint finish RAL 5015, clause **4.6** | There is no clause 4.6 and no paint or RAL requirement anywhere. Section 4 stops at 4.5 (`tender.md:15-25`). | The requirement and its clause number are both made up. Remove it. |
| 3 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz (4.1) | Matches 4.1 (`tender.md:17`) | The requirement is right. But the offer is quoted as "400 V 50 Hz" with no phase, so check that it says 3-phase. |

## Requirements the analysis misses

- **4.2 + 9.1 + 9.3: motor efficiency.** P-01 is 90 kW, which is over 75 kW, so it must be **IE4**. Section 9 overrides Section 4. P-02 (37 kW) needs IE3 minimum. This is the easiest one to get wrong.
- **4.3 + Annex B: ATEX Ex d.** P-01 sits in the wet well, which is Zone 1, so its motor must be ATEX Ex d certified. P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous.
- **4.4:** power cables must be at least 2.5 mm².
- **4.5:** panel and motor terminal enclosures must be IP65 or better.
- **7.4: delivery within 16 weeks of purchase order.** This is a hard rejection criterion: offers over 16 weeks "will be rejected".
- **9.2: ambient design temperature of 50 °C.** Motors and panels may need derating or confirmation at this temperature.

## What I couldn't check

The repo has no offer document. It contains only `README.md`, `tender.md` and the untracked analysis. So I couldn't confirm any of the "our offer … Complies" statements, including the warranty and voltage lines. Someone needs to check them against the actual offer.

## Recommendation

Rebuild the compliance matrix from the tender. It should have one row per clause: 4.1–4.5, 7.1, 7.4 and 9.1–9.2, with 9.3 noted as the precedence rule. Each row should give the offer's value, taken from the offer itself. Pay particular attention to IE4 and Ex d on P-01 and to the 16-week delivery limit. If you point me to the offer document, I can fill in the matrix.
